item.title: Blackgate Welcomes In 'Fresh Meat' with Alien Free Play Weekend
item.description: You can play the 4v1 zero-gravity survival horror game Blackgate as the paywalled alien for free right now until Monday.

item.title: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger Graphics Comparison - PC VR vs Quest
item.description: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger arrived on Quest 3 a year after releasing on PC VR. We compared the graphics to assess the state of standalone VR.

item.title: Google Details Glimmer, Its UI Design Language For HUD & AR Glasses
item.description: Google Glimmer is the company's design language for the interfaces in coming Gemini smart glasses with transparent heads-up displays, and eventually true AR glasses too.

item.title: Top Dogs On Apple Immersive Brings You Up Close With Champions
item.description: Apple Immersive documentary Top Dogs brings you up close with spectacular champion breeds, but traditional filmmaking choices keep the immersion from taking Best in Show.

item.title: Fixer Undercover Spies A Quest Release This Week
item.description: MacGyver-esque narrative VR puzzler Fixer Undercover hits Quest on February 26, with PlayStation VR2 and PC VR to come later.

item.title: Underwater PC VR Narrative Puzzler Echoes Of Mora Release Date Revealed
item.description: Underwater PC VR narrative puzzle game Echoes of Mora will launch in April on Steam.

item.title: Iron Guard: Salvation Is Coming To PlayStation VR2 Next Month
item.description: Iron Guard: Salvation, a sci-fi tower defense game, is coming to PlayStation VR2 in March.

item.title: Prehistoric Survival Game Neolithic Dawn Adds New Sandbox Mode
item.description: Neolithic Dawn adds a new sandbox mode allowing players to jump right into the action.

item.title: The Best PC VR Demos In Steam Next Fest February 2026
item.description: The first Steam Next Fest of 2026 is live now through March 2, with dozens of PC VR demos to play.

item.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Δ Cross Reflections Will Be Playable At Live Events This Year
